metaTitle: Dessert Cups in Hamilton for Dessert Tables
metaDescription: Hand-layered dessert cups for Hamilton parties and dessert tables, made fresh the morning of pickup. Free pickup; order 48 hours ahead, or 7 days for a 96.
h1: Dessert cups in Hamilton, made fresh the morning of pickup
intro: Dessert Shot by Farhana has been hand-layering dessert cups and mini dessert shots in Hamilton since 2024. Pickup free in Hamilton. Collection is by arrangement, a 24 or 48 needs at least 48 hours' notice (a 96 needs 7 days), and the morning you collect is the morning your cups are made. Here's how to time it, and how to plan a dessert table you'll collect yourself.

sections.heading: How Hamilton pickup works
sections.body:
Ordering starts with a request, not a payment. There's nothing to pay online: when we confirm, we explain how to pay the deposit that confirms your order.

1. **Send your request.** On the [order page](/order), choose Mini Shots or Dessert Cups, a pack of 24, 48 or 96, your flavours, pickup and the date you need them. Add your event date and any timing needs in the notes.
2. **We confirm within the day,** by email, text or Instagram. Pickup is by arrangement: the location comes with your confirmation, shared with the person who ordered, and we'll let you know anything else we need from you.
3. **We make your cups fresh the morning of pickup.** Plan around your pickup date, not only your event date.
4. **You collect them in Hamilton,** or send a friend, colleague or courier. The cups come in boxes of 24 with no lids, so a 48 is two boxes and a 96 is four.

sections.heading: Counting back 48 hours to pickup
sections.body:
A 24 or 48 needs at least 48 hours' notice, counted to 9 AM on your pickup day, the morning we make the cups. Picking up on the 14th? Send your request before 9 AM on the 12th, or on the 11th to stay clear of the urgent window. A 96 needs at least 7 days, so for the 14th that means before 9 AM on the 7th, and there's no shorter option for a 96.

Anything under 48 hours is an urgent order. Urgent orders depend on availability, aren't guaranteed and carry a rush fee, but you can still ask: send your date and we'll let you know within the day.

If your date is already set, there's no need to wait: [send your request](/order) as soon as you know your numbers.

Choosing Saturday delivery instead? It only runs on Saturdays, so read the next section before you pick a date.

sections.heading: Prefer delivery? It runs on Saturdays
sections.body:
If collecting doesn't suit, ask about delivery: it runs on Saturdays to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. The fee depends on your location, so it's quoted as part of your total when we confirm. Until then, the order form shows an estimated total before delivery.

Choose delivery on the form and add your address and postal code. Want the cups at a certain time? Ask for one in your notes, and make sure someone is there to receive them. For more on how Saturday delivery works, see [Saturday delivery to Toronto and the GTA](/dessert-cups-gta).

sections.heading: Planning a dessert table in Hamilton
sections.body:
Layered cups work hard on a dessert table: every one comes portioned, and the colour is already in the layers. Sizes, how many to order and what each pack includes are all on [the packages page](/packages).

Let the layers set the palette. A 24 of the three fruit flavours, as 12 [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream), 6 [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) and 6 [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze), puts saffron-orange, glossy red and near-black violet in one box. All three are Classic, so it's $45 as Mini Shots or $99 as Dessert Cups. [Start a 24 of Mini Shots with Mango Dream](/order?pack=24&size=2oz&flavour=mango), then add Strawberry Fields and Blueberry Haze.

For deeper tones, [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno), [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) and [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate) each carry a ganache layer, Dubai with pale green pistachio cream and a green marbled swirl. [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) sits between the two palettes, caramel-tan under an amber top. Want the fruit trio and the deeper tones together? A 48 holds up to 8 flavours: [start a 48 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=48&size=5oz).

Collecting for a big table? The 96 comes with event-day pickup and a custom label option, needs at least 7 days' notice, and can have a presentation tray at extra cost on request. Planning by event? See [wedding dessert cups](/events/weddings), [baby shower dessert cups](/events/baby-showers), [birthday dessert cups](/events/birthdays) and [every event we plan for](/events).

Keep the cups in the fridge until it's time to set them out; they can sit out for about 2 hours.

sections.heading: Allergens at a shared table
sections.body:
Building a table for guests who avoid nuts? Leaving the flavours flagged for tree nuts off the table doesn't remove the chance of nut cross-contact. Every flavour contains dairy too, so there isn't a dairy-free cup to set aside.

Each flavour page on [the menu](/menu) flags its allergens, the full allergen notice is at the bottom of this page, and the [FAQ](/faq) covers allergens too. If anyone at your table has a severe allergy, message us before you send your request.

faqs.a: Yes. There's no charge to collect your cups in Hamilton, and pickup is by arrangement once we confirm your order. Saturday delivery is the option with a fee: it depends on your location and is quoted as part of your total when we confirm.

faqs.q: When do I find out where to pick up?
faqs.a: When we confirm your order, within the day, by email, text or Instagram. We share the pickup location with the person who ordered, and a friend, colleague or courier can collect for you.

faqs.q: How much notice does a Hamilton pickup need?
faqs.a: For a 24 or 48, at least 48 hours, counted to 9 AM on your pickup day. With less notice it's an urgent order, subject to availability, not guaranteed and with a rush fee, so send your date and we'll tell you within the day. A 96 needs at least 7 days' notice, with no shorter option.
The morning you collect them. Your cups are made fresh the morning of pickup, so choose your pickup date with your event in mind.
